summary: Short-range juggernaut who shreds melee champions with his leg shotguns and W machine-gun. He's tanky and slow, and his E flip is his only real engage. Out-range him or dodge E, and he can't trade.
threats: Passive (Echoing Flames): each leg fires a shotgun blast in a cone; standing in front of him in melee range eats them all.
E (Disdain) charges forward and gives him a shield; if it hits you, he flips you behind him and stuns you.
W (Purge) auto-fires at nearby enemies. In melee range you take constant damage.
R (Fear Beyond Death) at 5 executes below 25% HP and fears everyone nearby.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Urgot's E flip and stuns him back, and vitals deal true %HP damage through his tankiness. Fiora can dash in to hit a vital and dash out before his shotguns fire again.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his E flip; parry it and stun him back.
Lunge onto a vital, then Lunge out before his leg shotguns cycle.
Approach from the side rather than straight on; his shotguns fire in front of his legs.
Stay above 25% HP when his R is up; it executes.
matchups.early: Trade on vitals from level 1, but don't stand in melee range for extended trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R executes below 25%. Your R heal zone keeps you above that threshold.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while he can't trade back.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.remember: Parry the flip, hit vitals, get out.

matchups.why: Vayne out-ranges Urgot's W and kites him, and her W (Silver Bolts) true damage shreds his tankiness. Condemn knocks him back during his E charge.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up; stay out of his W range.
Tumble (Q) sideways out of his E charge.
Condemn him away when he charges at you.
Stay above 25% HP when his R is up.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He's slow, so never let him reach melee range for free.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R executes below 25%. Play away from him when you're low.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and kite; take plates when he backs.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape besides E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; armor boots.
matchups.remember: Out-range the W, dodge the flip.

matchups.why: Both are slow juggernauts. Darius out-damages Urgot in short trades with bleed stacks, but Urgot's shotguns and W machine-gun out-trade Darius in extended melee fights. Darius wins if he trades and leaves.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he walks up, then trade and leave.
Step out of his E charge path; the flip stun loses you the trade.
Don't stand in front of his legs for extended trades.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him to heal through his shotguns.
matchups.early: Even. Trade short with E into autos and leave before his shotguns cycle.
matchups.spike: At 5 both of you have an execute. Track his HP and land yours first.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with E. Gank after he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against his shotguns.

matchups.why: Urgot's W machine-gun and shotguns punish Nasus every time he walks up to stack Q. Urgot out-trades him in extended melee fights, and Nasus can only farm safely and outscale.
trading: W (Wither) him when he charges E to slow his follow-up.
Stack Q only when his E is on cooldown.
Don't stand in front of his legs for extended trades.
Stay above 25% HP when his R is up.
matchups.early: Give up some creeps and farm under tower. Don't trade into his shotguns.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R executes below 25%; your R gives HP to stay above it.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower; stack Q on cannon minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank when he overextends without E.
